Apna Janma Nakshatra kaise nikaalte hain? 🌙✨ Sirf 3 cheezein chahiye: birth date, exact time aur birthplace. 🔭 Logic simple hai: • 360° zodiac circle → 12 Rashi, har ek 30° • 27 Nakshatra, har ek 13°20′ • Har Nakshatra ke 4 Paya (jinhe Pada / quarter bhi kehte hain), har Paya 3°20′ • Astronomy Moon ki tropical longitude deti hai. Vedic Jyotish sidereal use karta hai. Sidereal = Tropical − Ayanamsha (Lahiri ≈ 24°) 🧮 Example: Moon ki sidereal longitude 45° → Nakshatra: Rohini → Paya: 2 → Rashi: Vrishabha ⚠️ Birth time pakka nahi hai? Toh boundary ke paas Paya badal sakta hai. 👇 Comment mein apna Nakshatra aur Paya batao. Reel save kar lo, kundli banate waqt kaam aayegi! Rahu-Ketu grah hain… ya kuch aur? 🌑🌕 Amavasya har mahine aati hai, phir bhi har baar surya grahan kyun nahi lagta? 🤔 Jawab hai Moon ke raaste mein. Woh Suraj ke raaste se lagbhag 5° jhuka hua hai, isliye dono raaste sirf do points par milte hain. Grahan tabhi lagta hai jab Amavasya ya Purnima in do points ke paas pade. ✨ Jyotish parampara mein inhi do points ko Rahu aur Ketu kaha gaya. 🔭 Is reel mein: • Surya grahan vs chandra grahan • Chandra grahan mein Moon laal kyun dikh sakta hai • Poora andhera kitni der rehta hai: surya grahan mein lagbhag saadhe saat minute tak, chandra grahan mein lagbhag 1 ghanta 47 minute tak Toh Rahu-Ketu koi grah nahi, Moon ke raaste ke do points hain.
